presentation.name: Write a report FAQ from the model, not from memory
presentation.summary: Writes a report FAQ from the Power BI Project and a screenshot of the landing page, taking each metric definition from the measure description rather than from the formula.
benefits: Takes metric definitions from measure descriptions, and stops when one is missing rather than translating the formula into business English
Requires a screenshot of the landing page, including the visible slicers and anything that appears only through a bookmark or a tooltip page
Asks for the refresh schedule instead of guessing one from the model
Treats a description an agent wrote as a draft until a person accepts it
Documents the metrics a reader sees, without treating a column that is absent from the page as unused
